title: Blank config makes the program die on startup
body: I left config.toml empty to test the defaults. The program exits immediately with a traceback ending in KeyError: 'llm'. Version 0.4.1, Python 3.12.

title: Getting 403 errors from GitHub after a few minutes
body: Summarizing torvalds/linux fails after a while with 'API rate limit exceeded'. Version 0.4.1 on Ubuntu.

title: Emoji in README breaks the output on the Windows console
body: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\U0001f680' when the README contains a rocket emoji. Windows 11, PowerShell, version 0.4.1.

title: Run fails waiting for the model on a huge README
body: With a 2 MB README the run fails with httpx.ReadTimeout after 60 seconds. Version 0.4.1.

title: Excel opens the csv report wrong
body: When I open report.csv in Excel every row is crammed into the first column. LibreOffice shows it correctly. Version 0.4.0.

title: Report page is empty on Mac
body: repobrief serve: Safari 17 shows nothing at all, while Chrome on the same Mac works. No errors in the terminal. Version 0.4.1.

title: Traceback on projects without a readme
body: Running on a repository that only has code and no README.md fails with FileNotFoundError: README.md. Version 0.4.1.

title: Stuck at 99 percent
body: The progress indicator sits at 99 percent for about five minutes, then the summary appears. Version 0.4.1.

title: Night theme for the report page
body: Please add a darker color scheme for the web viewer. White backgrounds hurt at night.

title: Would love support for gitlab.com projects
body: Most of my repositories are hosted on gitlab.com. Could repobrief summarize those too?

title: Crash with --format json on an empty repository
body: repobrief run me/empty --format json fails with TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable. The repository has no commits yet. Version 0.4.1, Python 3.11, Ubuntu 22.04.

title: It doesn't work
body: I installed it and it doesn't work. Please fix.

title: Repository names with a dot are rejected
body: repobrief run my-org/my.repo fails with ValueError: invalid repository name. Names with dots are valid on GitHub. Version 0.4.1.

title: Error when running on my repo
body: I get an error when I run it on my repository.

title: --out folder is ignored
body: repobrief run a/b --out D:\reports still writes to .\reports. Version 0.4.0 on Windows 10, Python 3.12.

title: Summary lists files that were deleted
body: Files deleted in the latest commit still appear in the file tree of the summary. Steps: delete a file, push, run repobrief run. Version 0.4.1.

title: Web viewer crashes on reports with tables
body: repobrief serve throws jinja2.exceptions.UndefinedError: 'row' is undefined when a report contains a markdown table. Reports without tables open fine.

title: Wrong commit count in the summary
body: The summary says the repository has 30 commits but it has 1,200. It looks like only the first page of the commits API is read. Version 0.4.1.

title: Window flashes and closes
body: When I double-click repobrief a window flashes and closes straight away.

title: CSV export has no header row
body: repobrief run a/b --format csv writes the rows but no header line, so spreadsheet tools name the columns A, B, C. Version 0.4.1.

title: Exit code is 0 when the run fails
body: When GitHub returns 404, repobrief prints the error but exits with code 0, so my CI job passes. Expected a non-zero exit code. Version 0.4.1.

title: Token in .env is not used when running from another folder
body: I keep GITHUB_TOKEN in D:\proj\.env next to config.toml and run repobrief --config D:\proj\config.toml run a/b from my home folder. I still get the 60 requests per hour limit. Version 0.4.1.

title: Memory use grows to 4 GB on a monorepo
body: On a monorepo with 300,000 files repobrief uses more than 4 GB of RAM while building the file tree. Version 0.4.1, 16 GB laptop.

title: How do I change the port of the web viewer?
body: Something else on my machine already uses 8000.

title: Can I use it without internet?
body: I'm often on trains with no connection. Is there an offline mode?

title: Does it send my source code to the model?
body: Our company is careful about code leaving the network. What exactly is sent?

title: How do I upgrade to the newest version?
body: I installed 0.3.0 a while ago.

title: Can it run every night automatically?
body: I would like a fresh summary every morning.

title: Which Python versions are supported?
body: Before I set up a new machine, which Python should I install?

title: Where do I put my API key?
body: Should the model key go in config.toml?

title: How do I get JSON instead of markdown?
body: I want to process the summary in another script.

title: Add a --since option
body: I only care about what changed recently. A --since 2026-01-01 option that limits the commits in the summary would help.

title: Support Bitbucket repositories
body: We use Bitbucket Cloud at work. Please add support for it.

title: Show token usage and cost after a run
body: It would be useful to see how many tokens a summary used and roughly what it cost.

title: Publish a Docker image
body: A Docker image would make it easy to run repobrief in CI without installing Python.

title: Choose which sections appear in the summary
body: I never read the file tree section. An option to turn sections off would be nice.

title: Export reports as HTML
body: A self-contained HTML file would be easy to share with people who don't use markdown.

title: Keyboard shortcuts in the web viewer
body: Moving between reports with j and k would make the viewer faster to use.

title: Configuration guide doesn't mention the proxy certificate setting
body: I had to read the source to find out about SSL_CERT_FILE.

title: README links to a page that returns 404
body: The 'Getting started' link in the README points to docs/start.md, which does not exist.

title: Explain every option in config.example.toml
body: The example config has no comments, so it's hard to know what each setting does.

title: Typo in usage guide: 'sumary'
body: The usage guide says 'sumary' in the first section.

title: Add a contributing guide
body: I wanted to send a fix but couldn't find how to run the tests.

title: Cloning a very large repository times out
body: The git clone step times out after 10 minutes on a 5 GB repository, before the model is ever called. Version 0.4.1.
